summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist per the spec. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (public loader plus private _resolve_path helper, standard library only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection with tilde underline in docs/source/data.rst after Utilities, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Design choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under data_list_key raises ValueError; items are shallow-copied so extra fields are preserved; type hints cover all four parameters and the return. Verification: all new lines measured at 120 columns or fewer. Not verified: tests were not run and black/flake8 were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed.
